    Architecture Explained

    What is Headless Shopify Development?

    Traditional Shopify Website

    Design and backend are connected together.
    Customization becomes limited after a certain point.
    Website performance often decreases with heavy apps and themes.

    Headless Shopify Architecture

    The frontend is built separately using React.
    Shopify works as the backend commerce engine.
    Your store becomes faster, more flexible, and future-ready.
    Shopify Engine

    Shopify Handles:

    Products
    Inventory
    Orders
    Payments
    Checkout
    Customer Data
    Shipping
    Synergy Execution

    We Handle:

    Premium UI/UX Design
    Frontend Development in React
    Performance Optimization
    API Integrations
    Brand Experience
    SEO Architecture
    Conversion Optimization
    Elite Advantages

    Why Modern Brands Prefer Headless Commerce

    1. Lightning Fast Website Speed

    Speed directly affects: Sales, User experience, SEO rankings, and Ad conversion rates.

    A React-based frontend delivers a significantly faster experience compared to traditional heavy Shopify themes.

    Result: Lower bounce rate, Better customer retention, More conversions.

    2. Fully Custom Design Freedom

    Traditional Shopify themes limit creativity. With Headless Commerce, every section can be custom designed, giving your brand a unique identity completely unrestricted by templates.

    You can build:

    Interactive product pages
    Premium landing pages
    Modern animations
    Story-driven experiences

    3. Better SEO Performance

    A faster and cleaner website structure directly helps Google rankings, organic traffic, and product discoverability.

    We optimize:

    Technical SEO Page structure Metadata Speed optimization Mobile performance Schema setup

    4. Higher Conversion Rates

    Modern UX directly impacts customer buying decisions. We create clean user journeys, high-converting funnels, and optimized checkouts.

    This helps improve:

    Add-to-cart rates
    Checkout completion
    Lead generation
    Customer trust

    Transparent Pricing

    Starting Cost – ₹15,000

    Why Are We Able to Offer This Pricing?

    Normally, custom headless commerce development is expensive. However, we are able to offer starting development from ₹15,000 because of our Shopify support ecosystem and workflow support as Shopify business partners.

    Applicability Rule: This pricing applies when the project is developed through our supported Shopify workflow and deployment process.

    Important Clarification

    If a client already owns an independent Shopify account and requests:
    “Build a complete custom React-based headless store on our existing setup for ₹15,000”

    Then the project complexity can become significantly higher depending on:

    - Existing store structure
    - API limitations
    - App conflicts
    - Third-party integrations
    - Custom backend requirements
    - Migration complexity

    In such cases: Pricing may vary based on project scope and technical requirements.
